mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_code_uploads (status, status_date, code_object_id, arch, lambda_id, lambda_version_id, user_id, stage_image, base_image, repo_name) VALUES (#{status}, #{statusDate}, #{codeObjectId}, #{arch}, #{lambdaId}, #{lambdaVersionId}, #{userId}, #{stageImage}, #{baseImage}, #{repoName})
mapper.select: SELECT upload_id, lambda_id, lambda_version_id, user_id, arch, code_object_id, stage_image, base_image, repo_name, function_name, async_function_name, status, status_date, message, memory, timeout, function_deletion_date, function_deletion_info FROM lambda_code_uploads WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}

SELECT u.upload_id, u.lambda_id, u.lambda_version_id, u.user_id, u.arch, u.code_object_id, u.stage_image, u.base_image, u.repo_name, u.function_name, u.async_function_name, u.status AS upload_status, u.status_date, u.message, u.function_deletion_date, u.function_deletion_info, u.memory, u.timeout, b.name, b.code_upload_id, b.dev_team_id, h.status AS lambda_version_status, h.lambda_version FROM lambda_code_uploads u JOIN lambdas b ON b.lambda_id = u.lambda_id JOIN dev_teams t ON t.dev_team_id = b.dev_team_id JOIN lambda_versions h ON h.lambda_version_id = u.lambda_version_id WHERE u.upload_id = #{uploadId}

SELECT u.upload_id, u.lambda_id, u.lambda_version_id, u.user_id, u.arch, u.code_object_id, u.stage_image, u.base_image, u.repo_name, u.function_name, u.async_function_name, u.status AS upload_status, u.status_date, u.message, u.function_deletion_date, u.function_deletion_info, u.memory, u.timeout, b.name, b.code_upload_id, b.dev_team_id, h.status AS lambda_version_status, h.lambda_version FROM lambda_code_uploads u JOIN lambdas b ON b.lambda_id = u.lambda_id JOIN dev_teams t ON t.dev_team_id = b.dev_team_id JOIN lambda_versions h ON h.lambda_version_id = u.lambda_version_id WHERE u.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND u.lambda_id = #{lambdaId}

SELECT u.upload_id, u.lambda_id, u.lambda_version_id, u.user_id, u.arch, u.code_object_id, u.stage_image, u.base_image, u.repo_name, u.function_name, u.async_function_name, u.status AS upload_status, u.status_date, u.message, u.function_deletion_date, u.function_deletion_info, u.memory, u.timeout, b.name, b.code_upload_id, b.dev_team_id, h.status AS lambda_version_status, h.lambda_version FROM lambda_code_uploads u JOIN lambdas b ON b.code_upload_id = u.upload_id JOIN lambda_versions h ON h.lambda_version_id = u.lambda_version_id WHERE u.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND u.status_date <= #{expiredBefore} ORDER BY u.status_date, u.upload_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.upload_id, u.code_object_id, u.base_image, u.repo_name, u.function_name, u.async_function_name, u.lambda_id, u.lambda_version_id FROM lambda_code_uploads u WHERE u.function_deletion_date IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM lambdas b WHERE b.lambda_id = u.lambda_id AND b.code_upload_id = u.upload_id) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM lambda_versions h WHERE h.lambda_id = u.lambda_id AND h.status IN ('UNDER_TEST', 'PRODUCTION', 'FALLBACK') AND h.code_upload_id = u.upload_id)
